references.text: The spies explored the land from the Desert of Zin to Rehob, near Lebo-Hamat, which marks the northern border of the promised land.
Joshua describes the boundary of the tribe of Judah as including the Zedad area in the northern border region.
Solomon held a feast with all Israel from Lebo-Hamat to the Wadi of Egypt, referring to the same boundaries described in Numbers.
Jeroboam II restored Israel's border from Lebo-Hamat to the Sea of Arabah, corresponding to the northern border mentioned in Numbers.
Ezekiel describes the northern boundary of the land with reference to Hamath and Zedad, reflecting the boundary description in Numbers 34.
Ezekiel's vision of the land allocation mentions the road to Hamath as the northern boundary, consistent with Numbers 34:8.
